title: Vida Residences
about:
Vida Residences Creek Beach is a distinguished 33-storey high-rise located in the heart of Dubai Creek Harbour. Developed by the renowned Emaar Properties, this exceptional tower offers a premium collection of 1, 2 and 3-bedroom branded apartments. With its seamless connection to the boutique Vida Hotel, residents benefit from exclusive à la carte services, impeccable hospitality, and immediate access to the beach and Creek Marina.

As the first high-rise tower in Creek Beach, Vida Residences delivers an elevated standard of living through refined architecture and luxurious interiors. Enjoy unparalleled views of Dubai Creek Tower, Burj Khalifa, and the wildlife sanctuary. From waterfront dining to modern wellness facilities, this Vida branded project in Dubai Creek Harbour encapsulates the ultimate in urban beachfront living.

characteristics_module.title: Emaar’s Vida Residences Creek Beach: Sophisticated Waterfront Living in the Heart of Dubai
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Branded Residences by Vida – Experience refined design and hospitality in exclusive residences developed by Emaar and branded by Vida Hotels.
  • Adjacent to Vida Hotel – Enjoy immediate access to the adjoining Vida Hotel with premium lifestyle and hospitality amenities.
  • Steps from Beach and Creek Marina – Located just moments away from the Creek Marina and the sandy shoreline of Creek Beach.
  • À La Carte Services – Residents can indulge in personalised services including 24/7 concierge, valet, and in-home dining.
  • Impeccable Dining Experiences – Dine in style at a range of culinary venues, including waterfront restaurants and licensed bars.
  • First High-Rise in Creek Beach – The tower’s elevation ensures unobstructed, breathtaking views of iconic Dubai landmarks and natural reserves.
  • Exclusive Hotel Rates – Vida Residences residents enjoy privileged access to special rates and services at Vida Hotel.
  • Panoramic Waterfront Views – Revel in captivating views of Creek Island, Dubai Creek Tower, and the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary.

location_tile.title: Where City Energy Meets Beachfront Serenity
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Vida Residences Creek Beach at Dubai Creek Harbour offers a prime location near Al Khail Road, seamlessly connecting you to Dubai’s major landmarks. Residents benefit from access to a comprehensive transport network, including four nearby metro stations and a planned pedestrian bridge.

  • 7 Minutes – Creek Harbour Public Viewing Deck
  • 12 Minutes – Dubai Festival City Mall
  • 15 Minutes – Downtown Dubai
  • 15 Minutes – Dubai International Airport
  • 20 Minutes – Jumeirah Beach
